{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for the President's leadership in dramatically expanding resources to find an HIV/AIDS vaccine.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for devoting at least $15 billion over five years towards global prevention, care, and treatment programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Since taking office, President Bush has virtually tripled the United States' annual financial commitment to the global war on HIV/AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the emphasis on prevention in the President's Emergency Plan for HIV/AIDS relief.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Endorsement of the President's Emergency Plan for HIV/AIDS relief's embrace of the Ugandan model promoting the \"ABC\" approach to prevention that encourages abstinence and being faithful to one lifetime partner, along with other behavioral changes intended to eliminate or reduce exposure risk.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for the President's Advancing HIV Prevention Initiative that emphasizes routine testing, early diagnosis, ongoing monitoring, and elimination of HIV/AIDS in newborn babies and infants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for doubling the amount spent on abstinence-only education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for promoting healthy relationships.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Recognition of the unique and special vulnerability of women and girls to HIV infection from abusive and coercive behavior beyond their control.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Encouragement of expanded efforts to address women and girls' vulnerability to HIV infection through legal and cultural reform.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for more efforts to eradicate sex trafficking and prostitution and their underlying causes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
